releases.summary: Review instance data in a polished Table, undo committed changes and follow Catalog Starter from authoring to gameplay.
changes: Responsive Table with quiet icons, descriptive tooltips, grouped navigation and contextual selected-row bulk review.
Native session-scoped instance Undo/Redo, atomic bulk apply and external draft conflict protection.
Offline playable Catalog Starter with typed catalog access and explicit publication/assignment walkthrough.
Reviewed model/Enum generation, native-style Inspector references, bounded update history and refreshed illustrated documentation.
releases.mitigation: Back up before upgrading. Review models explicitly; keep custom partial members separate and update user code after generated type renames.

releases.summary: Clearer first steps, stricter import validation and safer generated C# code.
changes: Task-based customer documentation, first-catalog walkthrough and current real Unity screenshots.
Fix exact large Float transfers, generated ID/name collisions, reserved C#/Enum/API names and malformed JSON Unicode.
Keep sensitive query aliases out of generated serialized Inspector fields. Review/regenerate existing code and rotate credentials if stored and shared.
Block Stratus installation during Play Mode. Runtime APIs, existing IDs and serialized formats remain compatible.
releases.mitigation: Review or regenerate affected ID/API code. If a credential was serialized and shared, remove it and rotate it with its provider.

releases.summary: Publisher-verified release information and updates through your purchase edition.
changes: Each retail edition follows its own purchase-store update route without a customer store selector.
Read features, fixes, security importance, affected versions and Unity requirements in the Editor.
Manual and optional daily signed checks, labelled offline information and a 24-hour reminder.
Integrity checks and explicit installation preserve separate authoring data and game saves.
Runtime APIs, existing IDs and serialized formats remain unchanged.

releases.summary: Unity 6 LTS compatibility, polished workspace and optional assistant integration.
changes: Minimum Unity 6.0 LTS 6000.0.85f1; 846 core Editor tests passed on each tested Windows Editor: 6000.0.85f1, 6000.3.27f1 and 6000.5.5f1.
Corrected endpoint opening on older Editors and keyboard focus in the transfer menu.
Refined Files compact actions, Help support contact and version-first Settings.
Optional Codex/Claude Code integration contains six guides and three C# examples.
Runtime APIs and serialized formats remain unchanged.

Stratus/Helio passed 25 Editor and 8 Play Mode checks on both tested LTS configurations. Emberfall is verified with Unity 6000.0.85f1/URP17.0.4; the bundled URP in the tested 6000.3.27f1 installation has an independent compilation issue.
